motion.title: Magnets & feel
motion.help: Conflicting layers align while your new turn starts. Independent layers keep moving. Maximum tolerance allows turns from any angle.
motion.free: Zero strength holds any angle. Lower damping adds spring-back.
motion.outOfTolerance: A conflicting layer exceeds the {{degrees}}° tolerance. Align it or increase tolerance.

algorithm.title: Algorithms
algorithm.noMiddle: An even-order cube has no single middle layer. Select a layer or use a wide turn.
algorithm.layerRange: The layer or width is outside this puzzle.
algorithm.tooLong: Algorithms can contain at most 20,000 moves.
algorithm.notation: Outer faces: R U F…; inner slices: 2R; wide turns: Rw / 3Rw; rotations: x y z. Add ' for inverse or 2 for a double turn.
algorithm.minxNotation: Face turns are 72°. Use U R F L BR BL FR FL DR DL B D, with ' or 2. R++ / D++ and their -- inverses turn a wide block by 144°. @U / @R / @F rotate the entire puzzle about that face axis.

keys.title: Customize keyboard controls
keys.clear: Delete clears a shortcut; Esc cancels.
keys.conflict: This shortcut is assigned to another action.

art.hint: Select one or more facelets. One image spans all selected facelets in face coordinates and travels with the physical pieces.
art.previewHelp: Drag the image to position it. Preview uses the same cap contours and coordinates as the 3D puzzle.
art.failed: Could not decode the image. Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP file.
art.tooLarge: Choose an image smaller than 25 MB.
art.sameFace: Choose facelets on one face to create a shared image.

camera.hint: Drag a face to turn. Drag the background or right-drag to orbit; Shift-drag to roll. Scroll to zoom. Two fingers orbit, zoom and roll.
camera.select: Select a sticker before focusing on a piece.

solver.title: Solve current state
solver.invalid: The state is not a legal state of this puzzle.
solver.already: The requested state is already solved.
solver.limit: The solution exceeds the current resource budget. Try Fast mode or a simpler state.
solver.failed: No verified solution was produced. Your puzzle has not changed.
solver.help: Computed from the current piece state. Picture mode preserves the identity and orientation of every piece. Shorter solution compares alternative group factorizations; it is not a guarantee of optimality.

agent.read: Read the current puzzle type, legal state, and animation progress.
agent.play: Validate and play an algorithm for the active puzzle. Return its state after completion or pause.
agent.input: Provide 1–200 legal moves, with at most 2000 characters.
agent.busy: Wait for playback or solving to finish.
